caption: The drawing depicts a wooden doll-like figure standing upright against a plain, light background. The figure has a stylized human form with simplified and angular features, including a rounded head with carved facial details, short hair, and a neutral expression. The arms are jointed at the shoulders and elbows, with the right hand shaped in a circular manner and the left hand extended with fingers together. The figure is dressed in what appears to be a plain dress with short sleeves and a V-shaped neckline, colored in light to medium brown tones to suggest wood grain; the skirt of the dress is indicated by symmetrical, horizontal curved lines. The legs are colored dark red or maroon to represent stockings or socks, and the figure wears brown shoes with defined soles and a slight heel. The overall coloration relies on various shades of brown and reddish tones, with the figure centered on the page and no other objects or background elements visible.
